parameters.name: InstanceRefreshTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance refresh task that you want to query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.
